searchText: Ok I wasn't aware of these and it seems there are a lot of differences in how the CBOR encoding is being done in Vyper vs Solidity. Maybe it's a good idea to standardize this somehow in an ERC. Keeping that aside, what are your concerns with the proposal? I guess Vyper does not want to write the metadata in the runtime bytecode. You can still do that by keeping it in the `initcode` container and not in the deployed runtime container. just that it complicates the protocol but it's unclear to me that it's necessary

excerpts.content:
Ok I wasn't aware of these and it seems there are a lot of differences in how the CBOR encoding is being done in Vyper vs Solidity. Maybe it's a good idea to standardize this somehow in an ERC.

Keeping that aside, what are your concerns with the proposal? I guess Vyper does not want to write the metadata in the runtime bytecode. You can still do that by keeping it in the `initcode` container and not in the deployed runtime container.

excerpts.author: big_tech_sux
excerpts.content: just that it complicates the protocol but it's unclear to me that it's necessary
